versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file from the project.
- Updated the SKILL.md to change the medical model from u1-insuremed to u2-med in the "模型配置" section.

Initial release of med-patient-blood-pressure-monitor-record:

- Enables structured recording of patient blood pressure, heart rate, and measurement time for chronic disease management.
- Strictly records only blood pressure data (no diagnosis, weight, sleep, mood, or account system extensions).
- Supports multiple input formats: JSON, CSV/XLS, TXT, PDF/DOC, and image OCR.
- Outputs standardized JSON with structured data and a concise natural language summary.
- Requires Python 3.7+; external libraries/tools are only needed for specific input types.
- Integrates with internal medical AI for data analysis; local-only processing is not supported.
